data.name: Chinku
data.gender_notes: Chinku is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Chhinka’, meaning ‘Moonlet’. In Hindu mythology, the moon is often associated with fertility, wisdom, and protection. The name Chinku carries the meaning “Moonlet” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chinku usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle and calming influence of the moon.
data.etymology: Chinku belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moonlet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chinku total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
